_comment: DEMO, not the default: the hall in which odometry drift has nothing to hide behind.
`open` is 30 x 20 m of floor with a border wall and nothing else: no obstacle, no floor marking,
no goal, two spawns on the centre line. Every other arena in worlds/ hides a wrong wheel
constant behind a collision; here the same wrong constant stays what it is: a number.
Drive 20 m straight and watch the odometry ghost (`o` in the window):
./lab sim --world open --config config/demo_open_odrift.json
then hold `Up`. The readout counts the metres the odometry believes, the dot on the screen is
where the robot really is, and the label between them is the drift in metres: measured `odom off
0.60 m` after 12 m of driving, `1.00 m` after 20 m -- the same 5 cm per metre, all the way.
Measured on that drive (seed 1, 0.5 m/s east from the spawn, 20.00 m driven in 40.1 s):
wheel_radius_scale 1.0    the odometry reports 20.01 m, the ghost sits 0.01 m away
wheel_radius_scale 1.05   it reports 21.01 m, the ghost is 1.00 m ahead of the robot
and both runs end with **0 wall contacts**, because there is nothing to collide with. That is the
point: in a furnished hall the same kind of error ends in a collision instead of in a number --
config/demo_odom_error.json measures 26 wall contacts for task T3 with a 5 % radius and a 3 %
lever arm. Here the error ends in a number a student can compare with 5 % of 20 m.
GPS is switched off for the run (`gps.gap` is the outage window of CONTRACT section 6.4, opened
to the length of the exercise): with fixes on the screen the ghost is only one candidate among
three, and drift is the subject. The IMU keeps its default 100 Hz, so the same drive can also be
used to check that the integral of `gz` is the yaw the odometry reports.
Nothing else is turned on: no slip, no odom jitter, no GPS dropout, no thermal IMU drift. One
wrong wheel constant and nothing beside it, so the 5 % in the file is the 5 % on the screen.
To hand, without this file: ./lab sim --world open --set odom.geometry.wheel_radius_scale=1.05
and the same drive recorded instead of watched:
./lab run --world open --config config/demo_open_odrift.json --robot muster \
--controller student/solution.py --seconds 60 --truth
_comment_tail: No fix, no obstacles: the odometry is the only position left, and it may lie.
